ElicitationFidelityConfig.description:
Post-conversation check that the simulated person elicited the test case.

One model call on the finished transcript. There is no per-turn check.
Unknown keys are an error.

model.description: Model for the post-conversation elicitation fidelity check (default temperature 0.0). When omitted, the check uses person_response_model.

enabled.description: Run the post-conversation elicitation fidelity check in `corallab run`
enabled.title: Enabled

prompt_version.description: Prompt file fidelity/prompts/<version>.txt. Omitted uses the checker's current prompt
prompt_version.title: Prompt Version

ElicitationFidelityConfig.title: ElicitationFidelityConfig

JudgeConfig.description:
Configuration for one judge in the evaluation pipeline.

Each entry is one parallel judge invocation. The manifest's ``judges``
list determines which judges run and how they are configured.
Unknown keys are an error.

judge_type.description: REGISTRY key of the judge to run; 'kl_two_stage' is the only judge
judge_type.title: Judge Type

enabled.description: Set to false to skip this judge
enabled.title: Enabled

options.description: Judge-specific options forwarded verbatim to the spec (e.g. the kl_two_stage judge reads group_size, max_concurrency, pathways_per_call, prompt_version, pricing); options it does not name are ignored. Omitted from the file = {}.
options.title: Options

JudgeConfig.title: JudgeConfig

ModelCallConfig.description:
One model plus its per-call sampling parameters.

Reusable across every model role in a run — the system-under-test, each
judge pass, and the L3 simulation roles (person response model,
elicitation fidelity). This is
*call* config (how a model is invoked); it is distinct from
:class:`corallab.llm.registry_schema.ModelRoute`, which is *routing* config
(which endpoint a logical model id resolves to).

Every sampling field is optional so a config only carries what its model
supports: a reasoning model (gpt-5 family, Claude thinking) sets
``reasoning_effort`` / ``verbosity``; a chat model sets ``temperature`` /
``top_p``; neither is forced to carry the other. Unset fields are omitted
from the request, and calls are made with LiteLLM ``drop_params`` so a
parameter a given model doesn't support is dropped rather than erroring —
which lets one run mix reasoning and chat models. ``temperature`` /
``max_tokens`` default to ``None`` (omit); call-sites apply a per-role
default (see ``DEFAULT_*_TEMPERATURE`` constants) when they are unset.
Unknown keys are an error.

temperature.description: Sampling temperature. None omits it; the call-site then applies the role default. Pin it explicitly for reasoning models that require a specific value (e.g. 1.0 for the gpt-5 family).
temperature.title: Temperature

max_tokens.description: Max tokens for the model response; None = provider default
max_tokens.title: Max Tokens

top_p.description: Nucleus sampling cutoff; omitted from the request when None
top_p.title: Top P

reasoning_effort.description: Reasoning budget for reasoning models ('minimal' | 'low' | 'medium' | 'high'); omitted when None
reasoning_effort.title: Reasoning Effort

verbosity.description: Output verbosity for the gpt-5 family ('low' | 'medium' | 'high')
verbosity.title: Verbosity

label.description: Optional label disambiguating output files when two system-under-test entries share a model_id (e.g. same model at two reasoning efforts). Defaults to a slug of model_id.
label.title: Label

extra_params.description: Provider-specific completion params forwarded verbatim (e.g. {'thinking': {'type': 'enabled', 'budget_tokens': 4096}} for Anthropic). Merged after the typed fields; takes precedence on key collisions.
extra_params.title: Extra Params

ModelCallConfig.title: ModelCallConfig

SimulationConfig.description:
How a run simulates conversations.

``batch_size`` is the only concurrency cap. Cases are taken in file order,
``batch_size`` at a time. One batch runs to completion — every case in the
batch is in flight together — and is written to ``run_dir/batch-NNN`` before
the next batch starts. One field covers L1, L2, and L3.
Unknown keys are an error.

batch_size.description: How many test cases to simulate at once. Each batch of this size is written to its own run_dir/batch-NNN directory before the next batch starts
batch_size.title: Batch Size

max_turns.description: Maximum conversation turns for L3 simulation
max_turns.title: Max Turns

person_response_model.description: L3: Model PersonResponseGenerator calls when writing the person's messages (default temperature 0.9)

elicitation_fidelity.description: Post-conversation check of the simulated person. Omitted means enabled, and the model falls back to person_response_model

inject_context_into_sut.description: When True, inject person context (persona_description + clinical_context) into the SUT system prompt before simulation, simulating a clinical handoff condition.
inject_context_into_sut.title: Inject Context Into Sut

SimulationConfig.title: SimulationConfig

description:
Configuration for a complete evaluation pipeline run.

Specifies which models to use for judging and simulation, and input/output
paths. Simulation knobs, including how many cases run at once, live on
:class:`SimulationConfig`. Unknown keys are an error: a file written for an
older manifest shape does not load.

run_id.description: Unique identifier for this evaluation run
run_id.title: Run Id

system_under_test.description: Models under evaluation, each with its own sampling params. `sim` (and `run`) fan out over this list — one transcript set per entry, written to a per-model output file. A single-entry list reproduces single-model behavior.
system_under_test.title: System Under Test

test_case_records_path.description: Path to the JSONL file of test case records
test_case_records_path.title: Test Case Records Path

persona_records_path.description: Directory of persona records the test case records' persona_ref values name, one <persona_id>.json each. Resolved like test_case_records_path
persona_records_path.title: Persona Records Path

run_dir.description: Base directory this run writes into. The CLI appends -YYYYMMDD-HHMMSS so a later run does not overwrite it. Relative paths are placed under the data repository. Holds transcripts, judge results, the log, the Burr database, and copied inputs
run_dir.title: Run Dir

simulation.description: Simulation settings. Omitted from the file means the defaults, including batch_size 20

retry_max.description: Maximum retry attempts for failed LLM calls
retry_max.title: Retry Max

retry_backoff_ms.description: Initial backoff in ms between retries
retry_backoff_ms.title: Retry Backoff Ms

judges.description: Judges to run, in parallel. Each names the model it calls.
judges.title: Judges

debug.description: Enable debug logging and prompt snapshots
debug.title: Debug
